failing_dimensions.evaluator_finding: Cross-domain challenge evaluates against a non-deterministic reference built from randomly selected topic insights. A technically accurate signal-chain analysis scored 0.374 (incorrect) because the random reference was about Lenz's Law. The same answer could score differently on each attempt. Most encounters still follow the pattern: present topic → ask question → evaluate text response — the GAME mechanic is not fundamentally different from a quiz, even with narrative dressing.
failing_dimensions.action_required: 1. Cross-domain challenges MUST have deterministic, pre-authored reference answers. Define 7 cross-domain challenges with fixed technical reference answers at build time (e.g. 'Design a motor driver circuit' → fixed reference about H-bridge, PWM, MOSFET selection, back-EMF protection). Do NOT randomly assemble references at runtime. 2. Add at least 2 encounter types where the game mechanic itself IS the domain reasoning — e.g. a circuit simulator where the player wires components and sees the result, or a troubleshooting tree where each diagnostic step narrows the fault based on domain knowledge. The player's ACTIONS (not typed text) should demonstrate understanding.

failing_dimensions.evaluator_finding: Topic-specific misconceptions are good (37 individual misconceptions across 16 pools). Keyword fallback at 50% is better. But: (1) the non-deterministic cross-domain evaluation means assessment validity is compromised for the highest-Bloom's challenge, (2) spaced repetition review surfaces topics but doesn't adapt interval based on performance, (3) no diagnostic branching — wrong answers always get the same generic 'here is the correct answer' feedback regardless of which specific misconception the player demonstrated.
failing_dimensions.action_required: 1. Fix cross-domain evaluation (see intrinsic_integration above). 2. Add diagnostic branching: when a player's wrong answer is semantically similar to a known misconception (from the misconception pools), provide targeted corrective feedback for THAT specific misconception, not generic 'the correct answer is...' 3. Add gold replenishment through mastery (master a topic → earn gold) so negotiate encounters remain accessible throughout the game.

passing_dimensions.preserve: Circuit Citadel, 6 regions, mystery system, category filtering.
XP/level completely removed. Mastery milestones (Novice→Master). Concept cascades. Knowledge journal. Gold only for merchants. This is a CRITICAL improvement — DO NOT regress.
Component Choice/Circuit Build stealth, semantic eval, knowledge reveals after attempts.
All content free, premium additive only.

biggest_risk: Non-deterministic cross-domain evaluation makes the highest-order assessment unreliable — same answer grades differently on each attempt.
